officer.starting_weapon: Begins the match with one usable shot.
officer.shot_limit: One shot total during the match.
officer.timing: May use the shot from Round 1 onward during the Officer's own ordinary turn.
officer.no_identification: No faction guess or identification of a third player is required; choose only a target.
officer.ordinary_shot_baseline: Treat as a one-damage shot under existing same-location, health, Jail, Command Room, and defensive rules, with explicit exceptions for early timing and identification.
officer.no_extra_shot_from_supplier: The Officer's one-shot-per-match limit remains even if a second weapon becomes available.

balance_test_note: Record Officer shot timing, target's actual faction, protection, hit outcome, and the eventual winner separately in every 9-player playtest.
